feedback_by_option.fil: Kailangan ng tamang batayan at tagubilin, hindi hitsura lamang.
feedback_by_option.en: A reliable basis and instructions are needed, not appearance alone.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi nakikita ang lahat ng maaaring kontaminasyon.
Maaaring mapanganib ang maling produkto o dami.
feedback_by_option.en: The wrong product or amount may be dangerous.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi pinipigilan ng iisang takip ang kontaminasyon sa pagitan nila.
feedback_by_option.en: One cover does not prevent contamination between them.

feedback_by_option.fil: Nababawasan ang paglipat mula sa hilaw na pagkain.
feedback_by_option.en: This reduces transfer from raw food.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi ligtas o maaasahang pagsusuri ang pagtikim.
feedback_by_option.en: Tasting is neither a safe nor reliable test.
